title: RED BARRELS LEAVE FIRE
why: His order: red barrels, after the first explosion, also leave fire that deals damage over time. A blast now leaves a small fire where the barrel stood, 7 seconds plus a short ember glow. It burns the player 5 every half second (never one a teammate lit) and machines and pillagers 22 a second, credited to whoever lit the barrel, and it never blocks a way.
now: A red barrel that blows up now leaves a fire that burns anyone standing in it for a few seconds.
